capabilities: Set up a vault with Bible chapter files and starter folders via a wizard
Read Bible chapters with a chapter picker and prev/next navigation
Select verses and create tagged study notes from the current chapter
Browse study notes grouped by chapter, section, or book in a sidebar
Run AND/OR tag searches and save snapshots to a search folder
extras: First-time setup downloads a bible-data.zip from the plugin's GitHub release (30-90 seconds on mobile); after that it runs fully offline with no telemetry or accounts. Text is World English Bible (public domain); section headings derive from Berean Standard Bible USFM.
motivation: The README states it is for personal Bible study but gives no explicit author motivation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read Bible chapters or organize verse-based study notes inside a vault.
summary: Bible study plugin that provides offline World English Bible chapter text, a mobile-friendly Bible Reader, and verse-linked study notes.
